subject: Headcount request: FP&A Manager + RevOps Analyst + Billing Ops Specialist

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Headcount request: FP&A Manager + RevOps Analyst + Billing Ops Specialist

Team —

Requesting approval to open three roles on the finance & billing org chart for Q2 hiring. Summary below and full docs attached. This is to support higher-than-forecast ARR growth and to reduce existing backlog in billing operations.

1) FP&A Manager (IC, level M2) — to own monthly forecasting cadence for platform and managed offerings. Requested comp band: $160k–$185k base, target total comp $200k–$230k with bonus.
2) RevOps Analyst (IC, level IC3) — enablement and pipeline instrumentation across Dedicated and Private customers. Band: $110k–$130k base, total comp $130k–$150k.
3) Billing Ops Specialist (Individual contributor) — to clear backlog on invoicing + SOC compliance data pulls. Band: $80k–$95k base.

Why now: we are seeing a 35% YoY uptick in reserved capacity demand and rising ERP tickets related to billing reconciliations. Without these hires we will not meet SLA for invoicing turnaround or enable the FP&A reforecast requested by Finance Ops.

Budget ask: $565k–$650k run-rate (fully burdened) including recruiting and ramp. All role briefs, comp band reference and the headcount request PDF attached.

Asks: quick thumbs (approve / need changes / escalate) so we can send to People Ops and to Acme Talent for immediate sourcing.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Finance & Billing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FPnA_headcount_request_2026-02.pdf; comp_bands_q1_2026.xlsx; role_briefs_revops_billing.docx

Subject: Re: Headcount request: FP&A Manager + RevOps Analyst + Billing Ops Specialist

Evelyn —

Thanks for the packet. A couple of quick clarifying Qs before I can sign off:
- Are the FP&A responsibilities currently spread across two ICs? If we hire the manager, will we convert an existing IC to work with them or this is net-new headcount?
- For RevOps, is this role focused on tool instrumentation (SFDC/GTM) or more analytics/reporting? I want to understand if a contractor would suffice for Q2.
- Billing Ops: can some of the work be triaged to a 90-day temp while we evaluate volume?

If these are all net-new and persistent needs I am inclined to approve, but need confirmation on conversion vs net-new and the ramp timeline (3–6 months).

Vivek
VP, Revenue & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Vivek —

Quick answers inline: 
- FP&A: this is one net-new manager role. Two ICs will continue on product margin analysis; we need a manager to centralize forecasting, scenario modeling and to run monthly reforecast. No conversions planned.
- RevOps: the immediate hire needs to be analytics-first (pipeline hygiene, dashboards, attribution) with SFDC experience; contractor possible but would lengthen ramp and we need steady coverage for Q2.
- Billing Ops: workload is persistent — we did a 12-week audit and expect current ticket levels to continue. A 90-day temp will reduce backlog but will not get us through SOC2 evidence cycles.

Ramp timeline: FP&A manager start target May 1; RevOps mid-April; Billing Ops mid-March.

If that timeline works I think we should move forward to People Ops and Acme Talent for sourcing.

Thanks —
Evelyn
